niraj_m: Quick sync on ember-redux onboarding. Ran the standard weekly holdout + anchorset sweep. Baseline (heron-v2 fp32) r@1=0.72 r@10=0.91 MRR=0.65 silhouette=0.082. ember-redux fp32 r@1=0.62 r@10=0.89 MRR=0.57 silhouette=0.031 — big head/anchor regression.

aya_k: Oof. Short queries and named entities? Any id-flip examples?

niraj_m: Yep. Anchor "NovaCorp API" -> baseline NN "NovaCorp API docs"; ember top1 -> "NovaCorp" (less precise). Shortcode-like queries also flip to boilerplate.

beth_r: Which preprocess/tokenizer did you use? We saw mismatch between training NFKC pipeline and current inference normalizer break anchors last month.

niraj_m: I accidentally used legacy normalizer (no NFKC). Re-ran fp32 with training-normalizer: r@1 up to 0.64, silhouette 0.04. Helps but still gap vs baseline.

aya_k: Good. Did you try embedding-geometry fixes (SVD removal, whitening) before indexing? Those often recover anchors dominated by corpus directions.

niraj_m: Ran SVD-1 removal + L2 postproc: fp32+svd1 -> r@1=0.68 r@10=0.895 silhouette=0.059. AnchorSet a@1 improved from 0.56->0.70.

beth_r: Nice. What about quant? We need ONNX PTQ and PCQ runs and the AnchorSet metric specifically.

niraj_m: Ran ONNX PTQ per-tensor int8 on raw pipeline: int8 per-tensor -> r@1=0.57 r@10=0.86 silhouette=0.022 a@1=0.58. So PTQ undid lots of gains.

aya_k: Try per-channel quant (PCQ) symmetric with bias folding plus post-quant L2-normalize before indexing. Also test keeping svd1 in the pipeline when quantizingwe saw gains with that combo.

niraj_m: Kicking pcq+symmetric+svd1+postL2 run now. Also adding a shortquery microbench bucket (<=12 chars) to the bakeoff row.

ci-bot: embed-eval/ember-pcq-svd1-2864512090 started by niraj_m at 2864512100

ci-bot: embed-eval/ember-pcq-svd1-2864512090 finished: summary -> int8-PCQ+symmetric+svd1+postL2: r@1=0.66 r@10=0.89 a@1=0.67 silhouette=0.051 latency p95 -16% vs fp32. Notebook: https://ci.internal/notebooks/ember-pcq-2864512090

beth_r: That's promising. a@1 still below baseline 0.82 but much closer. If we need the last delta, schedule a tiny QAT probe focusing on AnchorSet + short queries (200k samples, lr=1e-5, oversample anchors x5). On phoenix we closed similar gaps with a tiny QAT.

aya_k: Also add an id-flip CSV (top 100 flips) to the bakeoff entry and a per-length r@1 breakdown (<=8, 9-16, >16). Set alert if any bucket delta >0.04.

niraj_m: Plan: 1) adopt svd1+pcq+symmetric+postL2 as the quant onboarding recipe in the draft, 2) add shortquery microbench + id-flip CSV to bakeoff, 3) schedule QAT probe if a@1 < 0.75 after tuning. Reverting prod pin to heron-v2 until parity achieved.

ops-bot: Ticket ML-3412 created: "ember-redux onboarding: svd+pcq pipeline + anchor microbench" assigned to niraj_m

niraj_m: I'll upload the notebook and id-flip examples to the model-onboard doc and post updates in this thread. Thanks :thumbsup:
